preserved_owners: Native advancement and FTB progress persistence

state_bounds.vehicle: One flight and grounded launch snapshot per aircraft, one sail journey per ship, expire after one Minecraft day of native updates. Current controller/session/position/native lifecycle invalidate. No scans or chunk loads.
state_bounds.thermal: One native impulse position/update stamp on native movement object, at most two native updates before accepted actual altitude gain.
state_bounds.gouge: One catch per online authenticated actor. Native failure/stop and logout/death/clone/dimension/server-stop cleanup, one Minecraft day expiry.
state_bounds.cannon: One pending projectile per fire call, three provenance UUIDs on actual spent projectile, native entity lifetime. Ammo observation capped4096slots.

criterion_persistence: Original completed criterion and action remain unchanged on all seven. Native advancement persists completed success. Only transient episodes are held here, no SavedData or second progress authority.
limitations: Production compile/reobfuscation and independent review remain parent-owned and unrun
Actual Mixin application and runtime remain unobserved
Two native grounded engine updates are an implementation-selected proof delay, not a new landing-physics guarantee
Offline dedicated sessions without trustworthy optional JEMIdentity admission fail closed

producers.native_evidence: Paraglider20.1.3 ServerPlayerMovement.applyMovement calls PlayerMovement.applyMovement. Observe finite positive native upward velocity increase only in actual ASCENDING state with both PARAGLIDING and ASCENDING flags. ParagliderDefaultPlugin selects it through Cfg.ascendingWinds and Wind.isInside. Require a following handleMovePlayer packet accepted through setOnGroundWithKnownMovement after collision validation, actual positive altitude delta from exact impulse position, same current native state, at most two native player updates. No desired velocity alone awards.
